subject: Best practices: local dev stability for Responses + storage tools

items.title: Centralize env normalization for emulators
items.rationale: Local dev often uses shorthand (e.g. UseDevelopmentStorage=true) that some SDKs do not accept; normalizing once prevents repeated failures across endpoints.
items.evidence: Connection string errors appeared in list/read/upload/filter tools until AzureConfig resolver was used everywhere.
items.action: Route all storage client creation through AzureConfig.CONNECTION_STRING (or a single factory) and never read raw env vars in individual functions.

items.title: Fix the write-path, not only the read-path
items.rationale: Self-healing bootstrap (e.g. handles.json auto-init) is ineffective if the write tool still fails on env/SDK issues.
items.evidence: handles.json was repeatedly missing until upload_data_or_file was updated to use AzureConfig.CONNECTION_STRING.
items.action: When adding auto-init, validate that the corresponding persistence path succeeds under the same runtime/environment.

items.title: Repo-wide audit for repeated env patterns
items.rationale: When one function fails due to config shape, others usually share the same code pattern; fixing only one leads to recurring incidents.
items.evidence: The same connection string issue existed across add/remove/update/manage/get_filtered/read/list/upload.
items.action: On first occurrence, run a repo-wide search and apply a minimal, consistent patch across all affected modules.

items.title: Bootstrap missing storage artifacts deterministically
items.rationale: Local emulators are non-durable; missing blob files should not require manual intervention during dev/testing.
items.evidence: tool_call_handler now initializes missing users/<user_id>/handles.json and continues without hard failure.
items.action: Treat baseline user artifacts (handles.json, interaction_logs.json, etc.) as bootstrap-on-demand and log the event.

items.title: Keep Prompt Tools as the source of truth (Responses)
items.rationale: Duplicating tool schemas in code and Prompt leads to drift; tool-calling should be controlled centrally in the Prompt configuration.
items.evidence: Fallback tools injection was removed to force correct Prompt configuration and avoid silent divergence.
items.action: Configure tools in the Prompt dashboard; keep runtime code focused on deterministic orchestration and tool execution.
